verdict: Leads up, cost per lead down — but overdue work is limiting your growth.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 40 leads at a cost of $38.94 per lead — a 37% improvement in efficiency over the prior week, driven entirely by Meta, which delivered all tracked leads as Instagram picked up meaningful volume. Google Ads ran spend across the period but is not registering attributed leads in the 28-day window, and there was a complete gap in Google delivery on October 25th; this is being addressed. Nine planned milestones — including heating campaigns, fall creative, and LSA re-activation — are now 26 to 87 days overdue, and until those are live, the account is running below its intended capacity heading into peak heating season. Google Business Profile engagement dropped sharply this week, reducing organic call and direction activity; a recovery plan is in motion. Next period, expect heating campaigns to come online and Google delivery to stabilize, which should broaden lead sources beyond Meta alone.
